title: CSS-Native Parallax Effect
summary: A tutorial demonstrating how to create parallax scrolling effects using native CSS features without requiring JavaScript libraries, showcasing modern CSS capabilities for web animations.
problem_solved: Enables developers to create performant parallax scrolling effects purely with CSS instead of relying on JavaScript libraries.
why_valuable: Provides a lightweight, performant solution that reduces page load overhead and improves user experience through native browser rendering.
